reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to SmartiLab again
reauth_confirm.description: Sign in to SmartiLab again: the access of Home Assistant to your account is no longer valid, or this version of the integration asks for one more permission (the commands of the modules, their settings, the alarms). Your devices stay here.

abort.already_configured: This SmartiLab account is already in Home Assistant.
abort.already_in_progress: SmartiLab is already being added. Finish that first.
abort.wrong_account: You signed in with another account. Sign in with the one already in Home Assistant.
abort.cannot_connect: The SmartiLab cloud does not answer now. Try again in a few minutes.
abort.oauth_error: The answer of SmartiLab was not valid.
abort.oauth_failed: Signing in with SmartiLab did not work.
abort.oauth_timeout: Signing in with SmartiLab took too long.
abort.missing_configuration: The integration is not set up.
abort.missing_credentials: The program of SmartiLab is missing.
abort.authorize_url_timeout: The sign-in page could not be prepared in time.
abort.no_url_available: Home Assistant has no address to come back to. [Read the help]({docs_url})
abort.user_rejected_authorize: You did not allow Home Assistant: {error}
abort.oauth_implementation_unavailable: Signing in with SmartiLab is not available now.

create_entry.default: Signed in: your SmartiLab devices are being added.

offline.message: The device is not connected now.

on_hold.message: The device is on hold: it can be seen in the SmartiLab console.

timeout.message: The device did not answer in time: it may or may not have acted.

no_remote.message: The licence of this Professional device does not give control from the internet.

not_writable.message: This value can only be read.

read_only.message: This device is shared with you to be seen only.

slow_down.message: Too many requests for this account. Try again in a minute.

unreachable.message: The SmartiLab cloud cannot be reached: {error}

no_scope.message: Home Assistant was not allowed to do this. Remove SmartiLab and add it again.

command_failed.message: The command did not go through: {error}

refused.message: The device did not do it ({status}).

auth_failed.message: The access to SmartiLab is no longer valid: sign in again.

update_failed.message: The SmartiLab devices could not be read: {error}

not_ready.message: Signing in with SmartiLab is not available now.

refused_denied.message: The device does not allow it now (for example a schedule holds that channel). Nothing changed.

refused_invalid.message: The device did not accept the value ({field}). Nothing changed.

refused_not_found.message: The device no longer has it: the integration reads it again.

owner_only.message: Only the owner of the device can do this.

one_hub.message: Pick the traps of one hub at a time.

alarm_fields.message: To set a new alarm, say the module, the number and the kind.

not_a_part.message: Pick a trap of a hub (a part of a device).

no_parts.message: This device has no parts that SmartiLab keeps.

run_action.name: Run a command
run_action.description: Runs a command of a module, with its input: for example a schedule of a relay board, the name of a trap, a favourite station. The device must be connected; if it refuses, nothing is done.

module.name: Module
module.description: The id of the module, as in the description of the device (for example zappy2).

action.name: Command
action.description: The id of the command (for example sched.add).

input.name: Input
input.description: What the command wants, by name.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: For a command that asks to be confirmed.

get_module_state.name: Read the state of a module
get_module_state.description: What a module says about itself: for example the schedules of a relay board and which channel a schedule holds now.

module.name: Module
module.description: The id of the module (for example zappy2).

set_alarm.name: Set an alarm
set_alarm.description: Sets an alarm on a number of a device, or changes one: above or below a level for some minutes, or no data for some minutes. Only the owner.

alarm_id.name: Alarm
alarm_id.description: To change one: its id. Empty to set a new one.

part.name: Of the parts
part.description: For a number of the parts (the traps of a hub): it holds for each one.

kind.name: Kind
kind.description: Above or below a level, or no data.

level.name: Level
level.description: The level, for above and below.

minutes.name: Minutes
minutes.description: For how long, before the notice.

back.name: Back to normal
back.description: Say also when it is fine again.

remove_alarm.name: Remove an alarm
remove_alarm.description: Removes an alarm of a device. Only the owner.

record_service.name: Record a service visit
record_service.description: Records a service visit on traps: pick the traps, or the hub for all of them. It is written on the cloud: the device can be off.

device_id.name: Traps or hub
device_id.description: The traps, or the hub for all of its traps.

get_part_events.name: Events of a trap
get_part_events.description: The last events of a trap: catches, emptyings, refills, alarms, service visits.

get_part_stats.name: Sums of the traps
get_part_stats.description: How many catches, emptyings, refills, battery changes, alarms and service visits in a period, in all and trap by trap. Without a start: since the hub was placed on its site, or the last 30 days.

module.name: Module
module.description: The id of the module (for example rattraphub).
